title: Agent Archivist CLI output envelope (archivist.cli-output/v1)
description: The single versioned JSON value a successful `archivist` command writes to stdout under `--json` (plan Phase 5: one versioned JSON value, diagnostics on stderr, never ANSI). The envelope is closed — four members and no others — while `result` is the one delegated member: each command's result document is a closed schema under schemas/v1/, attached to its registry entry (tools/cli-commands.toml, `result_schema`) by the phase that implements the command. The command vocabulary is append-only like the error codes, so `command` is pattern-bounded rather than closed to the registry: an envelope from a newer binary carrying an unregistered command token still parses, and a consumer reads the `schema` namespace to decide how to interpret it (the ERR-037 ethos). A failed command emits no stdout value at all (ERR-029). No floating-point values appear anywhere in CLI output.

x-archivist.compatibility: appending per-command result schemas and new command tokens is compatible (docs/notes/cli.md Section 8); changing the envelope member set, redefining a member, or a new namespace is a v2 event

schema.description: The output namespace (CLI-014): present in every envelope, never implied by context, so a consumer always knows which output contract it is reading before it looks at anything else. Security-bearing: an unknown namespace is not this format; a consumer fails closed rather than parsing it hopefully (VAL-001). v2 arrives only through the documented transition.

command.description: The command path that produced this value, with spaces replaced by hyphens (CLI-005) — `daemon`, `verify-state`, `catalog-rebuild`. The hyphen-joined form is unique across the command registry by construction, so the token identifies exactly one command. Bounded by pattern, not closed to the registry: commands are append-only within v1, and an unregistered token still parses.

generated_at.description: When the command produced this value: RFC 3339 UTC with the Z suffix (plan Section 7.3 — persisted and reported timestamps are UTC; local time is a display choice). Provenance-bearing: freshness evidence for automation, never an input to identity.

result.description: The command's result document. The envelope delegates this member: each command's result shape is a closed schema under schemas/v1/, registered on the command's entry in tools/cli-commands.toml by the phase that implements it, and additive within that schema per the Section 7.1 compatibility rules. A command that has no result schema yet has not shipped. Whatever a result carries obeys the content rules every output obeys: no transcript bodies, no secret values or reference strings, no unbounded or sensitive identifiers (SEC-004, CFG-027).

x-archivist.resultSchemas: per-command closed schemas registered in tools/cli-commands.toml, appended by the implementing phase
